doc.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002

title: His first real solo at sixteen in an R&B bar
summary: The first time he felt he played a real solo of his own was at sixteen in a bar with an R&B band.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: What was your first — is there a time or a circumstance that you considered a break, a big break for you?

Well it depends on what we’re talking about, a big break. The first time I soloed and I felt like I actually played a real solo that came from me, I was about 16 years old in a bar on Grant and Ferry around the corner from my house with an R&B band.
Wow. It must have made an impression on you at the time, for you to remember that.
